chapter: Lover Man and the postwar years
title: King Curtis and the Baby Grand
summary: He played with King Curtis on Eighth Avenue, at the Baby Grand in Brooklyn, then had a duo for about four years.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: All right, now that's in the Fifties. That's when I joined King Curtis. I played with King Curtis on Eighth Avenue in different places. Then I was down in the Baby Grand in Brooklyn.
Yeah. That was before I got my own duo together with ...(?)., a nice thing... We were with each other for about six years, I guess. '57, '58, '59, '60, '61 -- about four years.
